caption: Figure 11: Example of signal flow of gear signals during a single upshift or downshift Drivetrain Torque Distribution (DtTqDibtn) Differential Lock – All functionality related to the differential(s), which manage the torque distribution between left and right wheels, for example locking of the differential. Does not include the calculation of the distribution set point. Drivetrain Torque Distribution (DtTqDibtn) Transfer Case – All functionality related to the transfer case, which manages the torque distribution between front and rear wheels. Does not include the calculation of the distribution set point. Drivetrain Torque Distribution (DtTqDibtn) Torque vectoring axle transmission – All functionality related to active distribution of powertrain torque to all four wheels individually. Does not include the calculation of the distribution set point. For additional information on Drivetrain Torque Distribution (DtTqDibtn) please also refer to [4].
